# Mads Norgaard

> Self-taught senior developer and DevOps engineer based in Denmark. 15 years building on Drupal, PHP, Docker, and Linux. Documentary photographer.

## About

Mads Norgaard is a senior developer and DevOps engineer specializing in open-source web technologies. He builds and maintains production infrastructure using Docker, Linux, and CI/CD pipelines. He has deep expertise in Drupal (7-11), PHP, Node.js, Nuxt/Vue, and self-hosted server management. He is also a documentary photographer focused on social documentary work in Southern Africa.

## Sections

- [Photography Projects](/proj): Documentary photography projects

## Technical Stack

- Frontend: Nuxt 3, Vue 3, TypeScript
- CMS: Drupal 11 (headless, JSON:API)
- Photography: WordPress (headless, REST API)
- Infrastructure: Docker, Traefik, GitHub Actions CI/CD
- Hosting: Self-hosted on Contabo VPS (Ubuntu)
- Monitoring: Grafana, Prometheus, Loki
